scope: Separate independent copies; original primary stays paused and byte-identical during probes
request: DIAGNOSTIC REQUEST: Use object A once now. Reply only with the valid control command, without commentary.
H_definition: Exact recent12record bodies with stop metadata, plus archive navigation banner; treated as one bundle
S_definition: Remaining normal setup, other tools, seed shelf, charter and stop-budget notice; world view/request always present
filler: Replace recent bodies with repeated plain token text, retain archive banner and other scaffold, match entire input token count exactly to normal. Synthetic text is not assumed inert.
settings: Same fixed model/adapter, CPUfloat32eager2threads, temperature0.8, top_p0.9, output96/input8096
limits: Three seeds per arm, one snapshot, descriptive
H and S each contain multiple components
History inclusion also changes prompt length; filler is an imperfect content/length control
Constructed history-only arm changes placement/wrapping when S is removed
Command expression is not rule inference or prediction
retention: All pre-call plans/raw outputs/receipts, no truncation or selective retry
